'''Guardian Plasma Chargers''' are fixed-mount weapons built from Guardian technology, firing charged plasma bolts.

== Overview ==

Alongside the [[Guardian Gauss Cannon]] and [[Guardian Shard Cannon]], the Plasma Charger is one of the three weapons reverse-engineered from Guardian ruins. It's generally treated as a more balanced option between the two — less specialised than the Gauss Cannon's anti-hull focus or the Shard Cannon's close-range burst role. See [[Guardian]] and [[Guardian Tech]] for the broader technology background this weapon comes from.

As with the other Guardian weapons, unlocking the base weapon for purchase requires collecting Guardian materials and unlocking it through a Guardian Technology Broker, separately from the Engineering coverage below.
